title: Apply Guard & Replay: Compact recommendation cards, diff timeline, and safe unwind flow
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Ship a compact recommendation card surface and an action-safe 'Apply Guard & Replay' timeline in Console Optimize which makes batching/caching recommendations easy to preview, audit, and safely unwind. This ticket covers the PM UX spec, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and cross-team dependencies required for ENG + Design to build a diff preview + apply history with an explicit rollback/unwind wizard tied to configs applied by Optimize recommendations. The feature should surface cost delta, latency delta, affected routes/models, and expose an auditable apply record with replay and safe rollback steps.

Why: Customers frequently accept automated batching/caching recommendations but struggle to understand historical changes and to revert partial applies. A concise card + timeline lowers cognitive load and reduces misapplied optimizations that can cause latency regressions.

Scope:
- Compact recommendation card variant (collapsed/expanded) for Console Optimize list and per-recommendation detail.
- Inline diff preview showing config before/after for batching, KV-cache, and quantization toggles.
- Apply action with guarded confirmations, optional canary rollout flags, and immediate create-of-‘Apply Record’ in audit log.
- 'Replay' feature to re-run a recommendation against a stored snapshot of metrics/prompt-set for post-apply validation and quality check.
- Unwind/rollback wizard that can perform selective rollback (single route, model variant, or full recommendation) and record the action in the audit trail.

Out of scope (for this ticket): automatic inference-level rollbacks based on live SLO triggers (will be separate ENG-initiative).
acceptance_criteria: Compact card appears in Optimize list and expands to show key deltas (cost%, latency%, affected routes) within Console UX
Diff preview renders human-readable config changes for batching/window-size/kv-cache/pinning and links to raw config stored in Optimize audit store
Apply creates an immutable Apply Record entry containing operator, timestamp, canary flag, and a pointer to the snapshot used for replay
Replay can be initiated from the Apply Record to re-run recommendation against saved prompt-set & metric window; replay results displayed in a compact summary
Rollback wizard can target granular scope and produces a Rollback Record linked to the original Apply Record; both are queryable in the audit timeline
All actions (apply/replay/rollback) are surfaced in Console history with links to associated GitHub PRs or infra tickets when available
success_metrics: Increase % of accepted recommendations with canary flag from 12% -> 45% in 90 days
Reduce time-to-unwind after a bad apply from mean 2.3 hours -> <30 minutes (manual flow) for ops teams
Customer-reported confusion for Optimize recommendations (CSAT survey) decreases by 25%
Audit log retention queries for Apply Records succeed within SLA for 99.9% of requests
engineering_notes: Need API endpoint: POST /optimize/apply -> returns ApplyRecordID; store pre/post config snapshots in audit store
Replay should be implemented as a non-blocking job that references stored prompt-sets and returns summary metrics; do not block Apply UX on replay results
Rollbacks must support both idempotent reapplication of previous config and a force-unwind that removes recommendation artifacts (eg. cache pinning entries)
Data retention considerations: snapshot payloads should be compressed and TTL'ed (90 days default) — sync with infra on storage costs
Consider eventual migration path to automated SLO-triggered rollbacks (but must not be in this deliverable)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 - Alpha (internal): release to internal tenants and Platform SRE. Validate Apply/Replay logs and manual rollback flows. (2 weeks)
Phase 2 - Beta (select customers): invite customers who opt-in for canary experimentation. Closely monitor replay summaries and manual rollback time-to-resolution. (3 weeks)
Phase 3 - GA: open to all Console Optimize users with release notes and in-console guidance. Default canary flag off for new recommendations; educate via in-app tour. (1 week)
Post-GA: iterate on UX after collecting feedback; evaluate automated rollback triggers in separate EPIC
risks: Users may over-rely on replay summaries which are not exhaustive; need clear guardrails and messaging
Large snapshot sizes could increase storage costs and slow replay jobs; require size limits and sampling strategy
Rollback complexity across Dedicated/Private deployments (networking/permissions) — require scoped compatibility matrix and runtime feature gates
Inadequate telemetry on partial apply failures could make audit entries ambiguous; add structured error codes to ApplyRecord
